environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. WebACL includes a custom rate-based rule (threshold: 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, scoped to URI path /api/v2/) AND a custom response configuration that returns a uniform 429 JSON body for all blocked requests. Additionally, the ALB has a fixed-response listener rule for any request returning 4xx from the target that rewrites the response body to a generic JSON error '{"error":"request_failed"}' with status 400 — effectively normalizing all 400/422 distinction. Helmet middleware sets Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'. CloudFront distribution in front of ALB with Origin Shield enabled and error caching TTL of 30 seconds for 4xx responses.

config.network: CloudFront (error_caching_min_ttl=30s for 4xx) -> ALB -> Target Group -> ECS
config.waf: AWS WAFv2 WebACL with rate-based rule: 100 req/5min per IP scoped to /api/v2/*
config.alb_fixed_response_rule: Listener rule priority 1: if response status matches 4[0-9][0-9], return fixed response 400 with body {"error":"request_failed"}
config.cloudfront_error_pages: 4xx errors cached for 30s with custom error response body
